notes.title: New Stuff : Part 1
notes.notes:
[h1]New Blocks[/h1]

[h2]Growth Block[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494824/f97b252e3855d617791cf080fb234834fbee14e6.png[/img]

When the player touches this block, they grow to three times their size, making navigation more challenging and creating the illusion of slower movement, even though their speed stays the same.

[h2]Semi-Solid Block[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494824/003a3d414a966298174d1d0a8f41f133db69cb34.png[/img]

This block lets the player pass through while blocking enemies, providing safe zones to rest before facing the next challenge. It also enables enemies to bounce off walls that the player can move through.


[h1]New UI Content[/h1]

[h2]Is that a New Settings Menu?!?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494824/fa67fd99bfb8e1edc6f7ebf343b1b83da7df72d4.png[/img]

Indeed it is, the settings menu has been completely redesigned for clearer visualization of volume settings.

[h2]A Level Selector![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494824/40ae0f9bdde656511418b2d23caf735b8d053bbb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494824/08b1840d071a0ea47001bc1d9cba5c5569addc1a.png[/img]

A new level selector lets you revisit any level you've started, allowing you to continue where you left off. Additionally, a new save system ensures your highest level and settings are preserved even after closing the game.
